title: Jakubiak tasting Thailand and Cambodia
text_html:
Jakubiak tasting Thailand and Cambodia


Renowned Polish chef Tomasz Jakubiak travels to Southeast Asia to uncover the region’s most exciting culinary destinations, exploring the vibrant food cultures of Thailand and Cambodia. Along his journey, he visits the bustling and colorful streets of Bangkok, famous for its extraordinary street markets and rich culinary traditions. He also ventures to a remote fishing village to experience island life, learning how coconut milk is produced and how pepper is cultivated. Curious about the region’s bold flavors, Tomek samples some of Southeast Asia’s most unusual delicacies — including the famously pungent Durian and even fried tarantula. Meeting passionate local cooks, farmers, and food lovers along the way, he discovers the ingredients, techniques, and stories that define the cuisine of this fascinating part of the world. The journey concludes in Cambodia, where Tomek visits the capital Phnom Penh and the southern town of Kampot, famous worldwide for its exceptional pepper.

TV Channel: Canal+
Format: 8 × 22’ episodes
Location: Bangkok, Northern Thailand and Cambodia
Service production: ONESPROD

title: Down The Road
text_html:
Six young adults with Down syndrome embark on an independent journey across Thailand to test themselves outside their familiar routines and take another step toward independence. In the fourth season of Down The Road, the participants are accompanied by a new host, Monika Hoffman-Piszora—a mother of six, including two children with Down syndrome. The journey begins in Bangkok, a city of extremes where slums stand alongside luxury high-rises, tuk-tuks share the road with the world’s most expensive supercars, and unfamiliar customs constantly captivate the eye. From there, the travelers venture deep into Thailand like true backpackers—navigating bustling street markets, ancient temples, dense jungle terrain, and local towns—before ultimately reaching the tropical, colorful shores of Koh Samui. Across twenty days on the road, the expedition becomes a symbolic path toward adulthood and greater independence.


TV Channel: TTV (TVN Warner Brothers Discovery)
Production: Wiernik Pro
Production Service: ONESPROD
Format: 12 x 45′ episodes
Location: Bangkok, multiple locations all over Thailand

title: Fifty ways to kill your Mommy
text_html:
Fifty ways to kill your Mommy

In the TV show Fifty Ways to Kill Your Mommy, Polish celebrities take their mothers on an unforgettable holiday filled with extreme challenges. The show is about pushing personal boundaries, but it also brings plenty of heartfelt moments, emotional confessions, and humor along the way. In this episode, Tomasz Szczepanik – the lead singer of the popular Polish band Pectus – takes his mother on an extraordinary journey to the vibrant city of Bangkok. From the very beginning, it is clear that the mother and son share a strong and warm bond. During their stay in Thailand, they face a series of unforgettable experiences. The adventure begins with a high-speed ride in a racing car alongside a professional rally driver, reaching speeds of up to 290 km/h. The challenges continue as Tomasz’s mother performs in a traditional Thai theatre, tries parasailing, samples exotic street food at a bustling local market, and takes part in many more thrilling activities across the city.


TV channel: TVN
Production: Golden Media Polska
Format: 1 × 45’ episode
Location: Bangkok
Service production: ONESPROD

title: Green Revolution
text_html:
Green Revolution

Chef, author, and blogger Marta Dymek travels across Northern Thailand on a culinary mission to showcase the rich and surprising world of vegan cuisine. In this 12-episode series, she explores local traditions and gathers unique plant-based recipes from one of Asia’s most vibrant food cultures. Along the way, Marta visits rice plantations and fresh herb farms, discovers the traditional production of tofu, and learns how the region’s iconic soy sauce is made. Meeting local producers and cooks, she uncovers the ingredients, techniques, and stories behind Northern Thailand’s diverse culinary landscape. Filmed entirely on location across Northern Thailand, the series combines travel and food storytelling to reveal the depth and creativity of Thai plant-based cuisine.

TV Channel: Canal+
Format: 12 × 24’ episodes
Location: Northern Thailand
Service production: ONESPROD

title: Iron Majdan – Cambodia
text_html:
Iron Majdan – Cambodia

Poland’s most recognizable celebrity couple – Małgorzata Rozenek-Majdan and Radosław Majdan – travel to Cambodia, where yet another extreme challenge awaits them. The crowded streets of Phnom Penh are a true test of courage. The city is home to approximately 2.5 million cars and up to three times as many scooters. More than one-third of drivers reportedly do not hold a valid driving license. Traffic regulations may formally exist, but in reality, chaos dominates the roads. Fuel is often sold in recycled plastic soda bottles, and vehicle inspections are virtually unheard of. Driving under such conditions feels like an extreme sport for foreigners — making it the perfect mission for the stars of Iron Majdan. The hosts will cross part of the country driving a tuk-tuk, navigating Cambodia’s unpredictable roads to deliver a valuable package to monks at the iconic Angkor Wat temple complex.


TV channel: TVN
Production: Golden Media Poland
Format: 2 × 45’ episodes
Location: Bangkok and Southern Thailand
Service production: ONESPROD

title: Iron Majdan – Thailand
text_html:
Iron Majdan – Thailand

Poland’s celebrity power couple – Małgorzata Rozenek-Majdan and Radosław Majdan – embark on an extraordinary journey around the world, marking one of the most unpredictable and unforgettable experiences of their lives. One of the key destinations of the series is Thailand, where two episodes were filmed — one on a deserted island in the Andaman Sea, and the other in the vibrant metropolis of Bangkok. On the remote island, the hosts were challenged to navigate a demanding route through dense jungle terrain before constructing a raft from available materials and making their way back to the mainland. The extreme conditions, limited resources, and complete isolation created a highly demanding production environment. In Bangkok, the challenge took on an entirely different dimension. The couple met members of a popular local band, stepped into the world of karaoke, and ultimately performed on stage at one of Thailand’s largest music festivals, appearing before an international audience.

TV channel – TVN
Production: Golden Media Poland
Format: 2 × 45’ episodes
Location: Bangkok and Southern Thailand
Service production: ONESPROD

text_html:
IRON MAJDAN

The famous polish reality show, Iron Majdan with celebrity power couple, Malgorzata Rozenek and Radoslaw Majdan had a South East Asian leg. It wasn’t a journey just for the couple but an adventure for us behind the wheel as well. Over a course of 15 days, we shot them travelling in a tuk tuk from the Cambodian capital of Phnom Penh to the ancient temples of Angkor Wat, a staggering 314 kms! Did we mention on a tuk tuk?!

We discovered a national park in an uninhabited, unnamed, breathtakingly beautiful Thai island, where the couple made a boat from scratch. And on top of that we arranged for the show to include one of the biggest music festival tucked in the scenic Northern Thailand mountains, where the couple rehearsed and performed with the famous Thai band, Sweet Mullet!

What the three episodes entail for the show, make up for an unforgettable lifetime experience for us.

Director: Bartosz Łabęcki
Client: Golden Media / TVN

title: SAMSUNG
SHE’S MERCEDES
text_html:
SHE’S MERCEDES

It’s rare meeting exceptional human beings who are changing the course of our living through example and Kotchakorn Voraakhom is one of them. Being the world’s leading landscape artist, she is bringing Thailand back to its traditional amphibious nature.

With Mercedes, at the helm, we celebrated and honoured Kotchakorn’s life force as part of the prestigious, She’s Mercedes global campaign saluting women excelling in various fields around the world.

Traversing through diverse, jaw-droppingly beautiful landscapes in North & South of Thailand, we shot for this campaign over four days with multiple locations in the capital city of Bangkok as well, including the unbelievable Green Rooftop at Thamassat University. A smooth sailing and life changing feather in our cap.

Director – Aldona Kwiatkowski
Agency – Neuland Herzer, Germany.

title: SKODA SAFETY
SKODA TOPR
text_html:
SKODA TOPR

The Skoda Topr commercial says, ‘Reliability is the way to safety’ and with the dangerous task of driving on sleet covered roads at – 18° in the Polish Tatra mountains, our reliability was put to test. For three days in the middle of freezing winter, using high end equipment including a Russian Arm, we shot methodically and safely in the national park with TOPR, the Polish Mountain Rescue team.

The icy roads and unbearable cold made the driving and shooting a mountainous feat which, the One Production team braced & aced including the longest cable camera setup in the middle of the snow-covered forest.

Director: Kuba Michalczuk
Agency: GoldenSubmarine

And if you’re wondering, the marvelous mountains in the film are just a 2-hour drive from Bangkok.
